decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template builds directly on the firm's existing web and shop expertise, so it can learn from early uptake. It is visible only through a blog-style mention, which leaves some risk that it quietly fades.
Responsive website templates sit squarely within the firm's core web knowledge, so it can easily interpret their results and update them at low cost.
Premium support extends the firm's established service operations and draws on knowledge it already holds about its customers, making it easy to run and refine.
The version management tool has its own page and relies on the firm's in-house software development capability, which lets it improve the product from user feedback.

The data processing contract tool answers the GDPR demand that arose in 2018 and fits the firm's data-handling expertise. Its legal content lies further from the core and demand may fade after the GDPR peak, which raises the risk of dropping it.
